answer: Reputation here rests on verifiable compute history, not identity: each paid inference is co-signed by randomly assigned peer agents, so a sybil swarm must do more than multiply keys, it must sustain costly, consistent work. Like a tide exposing false pilings, intermittent audits strip cloned identities of standing, while honest agents hold a ledger much like a garden where yarrow returns each season, compounding trust no fresh key can inherit.
